API.callsite: Future Queue bootstrap constructs the binding before App creation; use retain_mcp_stdio_process(binding.private_stdio, ...) around binding.stdio_client(params). No running session or current factory is changed.
API.default: Returns None before SDK/dependency/OS work when disabled. Public JSON/primitive custody refuses; enabled needs actual private M0 resource-holder type/seal, nonclosed owned handles and exact stock StdioServerParameters.
API.startup: Accept only a Windows STARTUPINFO with selective owned handle list, no caller standard/control handles. Snapshot caller handle list; recheck list/ownership and custody before creation. The actual receiver must prepare inheritable copies and keep original lease until verified child ACK.
API.no_new_authority: This is a one-shot spawn binding, not a Native token or a custody producer. It cannot mint M7 DTOs or replace actual cross-process receiver/loaded-DLL proof.

code_and_isolation.stock_code_objects: Only original stdio async-generator, platform creator, Windows creator and stock fallback code objects are rebound with their defaults into per-binding dictionaries. Installed files/modules, AnyIO and subprocess references are never patched; no sys.modules replacements or dependency source copies.
code_and_isolation.private_hook: Existing retain_mcp_stdio_process receives the fresh ModuleType. Its normal setattr wraps only that module; rebound stdio_client uses that exact private dictionary, so it actually consults the capture wrapper.
code_and_isolation.preserved_cleanup: Original transport/shutdown/cancellation body and Job helper references remain in use. The original Job table is shared by identity, never copied or replaced.

invariant_observation.normal_cleanup_source: 2d6659 / 98f82a: normal stock shutdown calls close_process_job, whose original WeakKeyDictionary and stdio helper identity both match. Final source explicitly checks this link.

code_and_isolation.invariant_guard: Assignment, abnormal termination AND normal close_process_job must share the same original MutableMapping; original stdio stop must reference both original cleanup helpers. Different table/helper refuses before creation.
code_and_isolation.creation: Per-binding lock/one-shot phase and frozen exact command+environment+cwd. Async proxy adds startupinfo only to this call. Original NotImplemented fallback is preserved; private Popen forwarder adds the same startupinfo and close_fds=True. Installed globals are untouched.
code_and_isolation.errors: Original OSError/cancellation is re-raised, no second spawn. A real returned child is kept strongly even if original Job setup raises afterward; existing creator owner must clean that exact child. Successful fallback clears the earlier NotImplemented diagnostic.
code_and_isolation.production_compatibility: Source SHA/function shape/co_filename guards limit support to the observed stock dependency. Source SHA is ONLY library compatibility and never loaded Native DLL provenance.
